sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 早上好，各位。

sentences.en: In the last few lectures I've been dealing with business finance, but now I'm going to move on to business systems.
sentences.zh: 在最近几次讲座中，我一直在讲解企业财务，但现在我将转向企业系统。

sentences.en: And in today's lecture I'm going to talk about what can go wrong when businesses try to copy their own best practices.
sentences.zh: 在今天的讲座中，我将探讨企业在试图复制自身最佳实践时可能出现的问题。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com 7. 3500 Once a business has successfully introduced a new process - managing a branch bank, say, or selling a new product - the parent organisation naturally wants to repeat that OpSage.com success, and capture it if possible on a bigger scale.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 7. 3500 当一家企业成功引入一项新流程——例如管理一家分行银行，或销售一种新产品——母公司自然希望在更大范围内重复这一成功，并尽可能将其固化下来。

sentences.en: The goal, then, is to utilise existing knowledge and not to generate new knowledge.
sentences.zh: 因此，目标是利用现有知识，而非创造新知识。

sentences.en: It's a less glamorous activity than pure innovation, but it actually happens more often, as a matter of fact.
sentences.zh: 这比纯粹的创新活动显得不那么光鲜，但事实上，它发生的频率反而更高。

sentences.en: However, surprisingly, getting things right the second time is not necessarily any simpler than it was the first time.
sentences.zh: 然而，令人惊讶的是，第二次把事情做对，未必比第一次更简单。

sentences.en: Now, there's been a lot of research into how companies can repeat their previous successes, and it certainly hasn't been confined to the United States.
sentences.zh: 目前已有大量研究探讨企业如何重复以往的成功，而且这些研究绝不仅限于美国。

sentences.en: It seems that most large industries are trying to repeat their own successes, and manage the knowledge they've acquired - but even so it has been shown that the overwhelming majority of attempts fail.
sentences.zh: 似乎大多数大型行业都在努力复制自身的成功，并管理所获得的知识——但即便如此，研究表明，绝大多数此类尝试均以失败告终。

sentences.en: A host of studies confirm this, covering a wide range of business settings: branch banks, retail stores, real estate agencies, factories, call centres to name but a few.
sentences.zh: 大量研究证实了这一点，涵盖范围广泛的商业场景：分行银行、零售门店、房地产中介、工厂、呼叫中心，仅举几例。

sentences.en: So why do so few managers get things right the second or third time?
sentences.zh: 那么，为何如此之少的管理者能在第二次或第三次尝试中做对呢？

sentences.en: Let's consider one reason for failure - placing too much trust in the people who are running the successful operation, the 'experts' shall we say.
sentences.zh: 让我们先考虑一种失败原因——即过度信赖正在运行成功业务的人员，我们姑且称之为‘专家’。

sentences.en: Managers who want to apply existing knowledge typically start off by going to an expert - such as the person who designed and is running a successful department store - and picking their brains.
sentences.zh: 希望应用现有知识的管理者通常首先会去找一位专家——比如设计并运营一家成功百货商店的人——向其请教。

sentences.en: Now, this approach can be used if you want to gain a rough understanding of a particular system, or understand smaller, isolated problems.
sentences.zh: 这种做法若仅用于粗略了解某一特定系统，或理解较小、孤立的问题，尚可采用。

sentences.en: The trouble is, even the expert doesn't fully grasp the whole thing because when it comes to complex systems, the individual components of the process are interwoven with one another.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，即便是专家也无法完全把握整个系统，因为就复杂系统而言，该流程的各个组成部分彼此交织、相互关联。

sentences.en: The expert never has complete access to the necessary information.
sentences.zh: 专家永远无法获取全部必要信息。

sentences.en: And the situation's complicated even further by the fact that experts are usually not aware of their own ignorance.
sentences.zh: 而情况更趋复杂的是，专家通常并未意识到自身存在知识盲区。

sentences.en: The ignorance can take various forms.
sentences.zh: 这种无知可能呈现多种形式。

sentences.en: For instance, a lot of details of the system are invisible to managers.
sentences.zh: 例如，该系统的许多细节对管理者而言是不可见的。

sentences.en: Some may be difficult to describe - learned on the job and well known by workers perhaps, but impossible to describe in a way that's helpful.
sentences.zh: 其中一些细节可能难以描述——或许是在岗实践中习得、员工们心知肚明，却无法以有用的方式加以表述。

sentences.en: And there are some things that people know or do that they're not even aware of.
sentences.zh: 还有一些事情，人们知道或在做，却甚至未意识到自己知道或在做。

sentences.en: Now, let's consider two types of mistake that can occur when a manager actually starts to set up a duplicate system to replicate a successful process.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来看管理者在实际着手建立一个复制成功流程的同类系统时，可能发生的两类错误。

sentences.en: Firstly, perhaps he forgets that he was just trying to copy another process, and starts trying to improve on it.
sentences.zh: 第一种，或许是他忘了自己本意只是复制另一套流程，转而开始试图改进它。

sentences.en: Another mistake is trying to use the best parts of various different systems, in the hope of creating the perfect combination.
sentences.zh: 另一种错误是试图拼凑多个不同系统中的所谓‘最佳部分’，以期打造出完美组合。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, attempts like these usually turn out to be misguided and lead to problems.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，诸如此类的尝试往往事与愿违，并引发问题。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, for various reasons.
sentences.zh: 原因多种多样。

sentences.en: Perhaps there weren't really any advantages after all, because the information wasn't accurate.
sentences.zh: 或许根本就不存在任何优势，因为所依据的信息并不准确。

sentences.en: Or perhaps the business settings weren't really comparable.
sentences.zh: 又或许相关商业环境实际上并不具备可比性。

sentences.en: More typically, the advantages are real enough, but there are also disadvantages that have been overlooked.
sentences.zh: 更常见的情况是，优势确实存在，但同时被忽视的劣势也同样真实。

sentences.en: For example, the modifications might compromise safety in some way.
sentences.zh: 例如，这些修改可能在某种程度上危及安全。

sentences.en: So, what's the solution?
sentences.zh: 那么，解决方案是什么？

sentences.en: Well, don't intend to suggest that it's easy to get things right the second time it's not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我并非要暗示第二次把事情做对很容易——事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But the underlying problem has more to do with attitudes than the actual difficulty of the task, and there are ways of getting it right.
sentences.zh: 但根本问题更多关乎态度，而非任务本身的实际难度；而且，确实存在把事情做对的方法。

sentences.en: These involve adjusting attitudes, first of all being more realistic and cautious really.
sentences.zh: 这些方法首先涉及调整态度，即首先要更加务实和谨慎。

sentences.en: Secondly, they involve exerting strict controls on the organisational and operational systems.
sentences.zh: 其次，它们要求对企业组织与运营系统实施严格管控。

sentences.en: And this in turn means copying the original as closely as possible.
sentences.zh: 而这反过来意味着应尽可能忠实地复制原始系统。

sentences.zh: 不仅仅是复制工厂的物理特征 www.TopSage.com 录音稿 †。
